parameters.content:
## Google Maps Grid-Based Market Saturation Scanner

**Actor:** [Google Maps Grid-Based Market Saturation Scanner](https://apify.com/dataspryva/google-maps-grid-based-market-saturation-scanner)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/google-maps-grid-based-market-saturation-scanner.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `searchQuery` (string, required)
- `locationName` (string)
- `boundingBox` (object)
- `circleCenter` (object)
- `radiusKm` (number)
- `customGeolocation` (object)
- `zoomLevel` (integer)
- `maxPlacesPerCell` (integer)
- `maxPagesPerCell` (integer)
- `maxTotalResults` (integer)
- `deduplicateResults` (boolean)
- `enrichDetails` (boolean)

### Output fields
- `name` (Name)
- `categoryName` (Category)
- `totalScore` (Rating)
- `reviewsCount` (Reviews)
- `address` (Address)
- `phone` (Phone)
- `website` (Website)
- `placeId` (Place Id)
- `featureId` (Feature Id)
- `kgmid` (Kgmid)
- `googleMapsUrl` (Google Maps Url)
- `location` (Location)

description: Google Maps search beyond 120 results: runs the Google Maps Grid-Based Market Saturation Scanner Apify Actor, returns name, categoryName, totalScore, reviewsCount, phone and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
